notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hello and thanks for your valuable feedback! 

An update is being pushed today to address the following:


* Longer spawn time for balls (you can actually destroy a wall with one ball now, sounds like that should be a new achievement..)

* The angle of the ball as it is served is now closer together so you don't have to reach so far with the paddle

* The first wall has the Angel sitting further back and lower, allowing for the ball to bounce before you hit it.
